constraints:
task_results_pkey:PRIMARY KEY (task_id)
task_results_task_id_fkey:FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
task_results_token_check:CHECK ((token >= 1))
tasks_attempts_check:CHECK ((attempts >= 0))
tasks_max_attempts_check:CHECK ((max_attempts > 0))
tasks_pkey:PRIMARY KEY (id)
tasks_priority_check:CHECK (((priority >= 1) AND (priority <= 3)))
tasks_record_id_fkey:FOREIGN KEY (record_id) REFERENCES referrals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
tasks_seed_check:CHECK (((seed >= 0) AND (seed <= 2147483647)))
tasks_status_check:CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['queued'::character varying, 'running'::character varying, 'done'::character varying, 'failed'::character varying])::text[])))
tasks_token_check:CHECK ((token >= 0))
indexes:
idx_tasks_claim:CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_claim ON public.tasks USING btree (status, priority DESC, created_at, id)
idx_tasks_record_id:CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_record_id ON public.tasks USING btree (record_id)
task_results_pkey:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX task_results_pkey ON public.task_results USING btree (task_id)
tasks_pkey:CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tasks_pkey ON public.tasks USING btree (id)
